title: Developer Footprint V1 shared definitions
description: Structural definitions shared by the V1 schemas. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express portably (URL normalization, Unicode text rules, calendar validity, cross-field consistency) are normative in SPEC.md and are enforced by validators in addition to these schemas.

timestamp.description: UTC, second precision, exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Must also be a real calendar time (SPEC.md §3.3).

url.description: Normalized absolute https URL with no credentials, port, query or fragment (SPEC.md §3.4).

name.description: Plain display text, 1-100 characters. Never HTML or Markdown (SPEC.md §3.5).

description.description: Plain display text, 1-500 characters, single line (SPEC.md §3.5).

publicKey.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, canonical base64url without padding. The final character is restricted to the values whose unused trailing bits are zero.

signatureValue.description: Raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature, canonical base64url without padding.

digest.description: sha256: followed by the canonical base64url of a 32-byte SHA-256 hash.
